items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Oh, he's from New Orleans. Well, it was Paul Morais, myself, and, uh, Jack Pettis, and the rest of the boys were from, uh, St. Louis. So we went down there, we got the job on the boat

ctx.x: Uh, Rag Baby, Paul, myself and Tramonist, piano player. I just can't recall the piano player. Oh God, yeah. So, uh, we played the first set and went over pretty good and ragged. And the boss, uh, Stein was very happy. So I happened to go outside and somebody said, it's snowing. So I wanted to see snow and it was snowing like the diggings. You've never seen it before. I never seen it. I've seen it on Christmas cards, but I thought it was fictional. So I start rolling around in the snow and clowning and throwing…
I know who your name is.
